statement: This sketch creates an immersive deep-sea environment where bioluminescent coral formations pulse and glow with organic, flowing movements. The scene features complex coral structures that undulate with noise-based deformation, luminous flares that drift slowly through the water, and delicate threads of light that flow and connect throughout the space. All elements move independently in a continuous, self-contained animation, creating an ethereal underwater world where light flows and intersects naturally, without any viewer interaction required.
